meta.tagline: Independent cost benchmarks for Show-Me State farmers.
meta.data_notes: Mock data for Vibeathon demo. Benchmarks are real (extracted from MU Extension g658, g659, g651). Peer farms, quotes, and paid prices are fabricated but plausible for SE Missouri. All peer GPS coordinates are jittered 1-2 miles per Showline privacy policy.

quotes.sarah_notes: Detected supplier: MFA Incorporated, Sikeston branch. Quote date: March 12, 2026. Acres: 600 (corn program). All line items extracted with high confidence.

paid_prices.note: Found better fertilizer pricing at CHS

fertilizer.demo_rounding_note: Verdict copy rounds peer median to $305 and dollar impact to $33,000 for plain-English presentation.

verdicts.headline: Push back on fertilizer before signing.
verdicts.narrative_summary: Your seed and crop protection prices are right in line with what neighboring farms are paying. The fertilizer line is where the gap is — your quote sits at the 78th percentile of similar SE Missouri farms and is $55/acre above both the regional peer median and the MU Extension 2026 reference. That's roughly a $33,000 gap across 600 acres. The most common reason we see this gap is nitrogen timing — quotes built before the late-February urea move tend to land in the high end. Worth asking your MFA rep whether the urea + UAN line can be re-quoted at this week's prices.

primary_finding.mu_extension_citation: MU Extension g658, SE MO Corn Planning Budget 2026

amber_items.label: Crop insurance
amber_items.commentary: $2/acre above peer median — likely a coverage-level difference, not a pricing issue

recommended_actions: Ask MFA to re-quote the urea + UAN line at this week's prices.
Get a parallel quote from CHS Sikeston — three peers within 15 miles signed there at $295–$302/acre.
If the rep won't move on fertilizer, ask for a credit on crop insurance to net out the gap.

fair.criteria: All categories within ~5% of both benchmarks; total gap under $5,000 operation-wide.
fair.action_copy: You're priced in line with the regional market. Sign with confidence.

negotiable.criteria: 1-2 line items meaningfully over benchmarks, OR $5,000-$15,000 total gap.
negotiable.action_copy: Push back on specific items before signing. Potential savings: $X.

overpriced.criteria: 3+ line items high, OR more than $15,000 total gap.
overpriced.action_copy: Don't sign as written. Renegotiate before committing.

messages.negative: At these levels, you cannot cover operating costs. Consider revisiting input commitments before signing.
messages.connection_to_verdict: This projection uses your quoted costs. If you can negotiate fertilizer down to the regional median, you'd add $33,000 to your margin at every scenario.

summary_sentences: Three of five cost lines on this quote are in line with the regional market; fertilizer is $55/acre above both peer paid prices and the MU Extension 2026 reference.
Negotiating fertilizer to the regional median would add roughly $33,000 to Mueller Family Farms' projected margin without changing any other operating assumption.

post_contract_followups.question_text: Did you sign your March fertilizer quote? What was the final per-acre price?

principles: Your name never appears on any other farmer's screen.
Your farm's exact location is never shared — coordinates are jittered 1-2 miles before any peer sees them.
You're never the only farm in a benchmark — minimum group size is 5.
You can opt out of peer contribution any time with one toggle. Your own analyses still work.
Showline never sells, shares, or licenses your data to input suppliers, co-ops, or lenders.
You can delete your data at any time.
